v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Proprio de Tempore

text.la: Sacérdos in ætérnum * Christus Dóminus secúndum órdinem Melchísedech, panem et vinum óbtulit.
text.en: Christ the Lord, being made an High Priest for ever * after the order of Melchisedec, hath offered bread and wine.

text.la: Miserátor Dóminus * escam dedit timéntibus se in memóriam suórum mirabílium.
text.en: He hath made His wonderful works to be remembered; * the Lord is gracious and full of compassion. He hath given meat unto them that fear Him.

text.la: Cálicem salutáris * accípiam: et sacrificábo hóstiam laudis.
text.en: I will take the cup of salvation, * and offer the sacrifice of thanksgiving.

text.la: Sicut novéllæ olivárum, * Ecclésiæ fílii sint in circúitu mensæ Dómini.
text.en: Let the children of the Church be like olive-plants * round about the table of the Lord.

text.la: Qui pacem * ponit fines Ecclésiæ, fruménti ádipe sátiat nos Dóminus.
text.en: The Lord, That maketh peace in the borders of the Church, * filleth her with the finest of the wheat.

text.la: Fratres: Ego enim accépi a Dómino quod et trádidi vobis, quóniam Dóminus Iesus, in qua nocte tradebátur, accépit panem, et grátias agens fregit, et dixit: Accípite et manducáte: hoc est corpus meum, quod pro vobis tradétur: hoc fácite in meam commemoratiónem.
text.en: Brothers: For I have received of the Lord that which also I delivered unto you, that the Lord Jesus, the same night in which he was betrayed, took bread. And giving thanks, broke, and said: Take ye, and eat: this is my body, which shall be delivered for you: this do for the commemoration of me.

v.la: Panem de cælo præstitísti eis, allelúia.
v.en: Thou didst send them from heaven, alleluia.

r.la: Omne delectaméntum in se habéntem, allelúia.
r.en: Bread able to content every man's delight, alleluia.

text.la: O sacrum convívium, * in quo Christus súmitur: recólitur memória passiónis eius: mens implétur grátia: et futúræ glóriæ nobis pignus datur, allelúia.
text.en: Holy exceedingly is the Supper of the Lord, * wherein we do feed on Christ, do show His death till He come, do get grace abundantly to our souls, and do take pledge of the glory which shall hereafter be revealed in us, alleluia.

text.la: Deus, qui nobis sub Sacraménto mirábili passiónis tuæ memóriam reliquísti: tríbue, quǽsumus, ita nos Córporis, et Sánguinis tui sacra mystéria venerári; ut redemptiónis tuæ fructum in nobis iúgiter sentiámus:
text.en: O God, under a marvelous sacrament you have left us the memorial of thy Passion; grant us, we beseech thee, so to venerate the sacred mysteries of thy Body and Blood, that we may ever perceive within us the fruit of thy Redemption.
